title: The fixed rule on every training seed of net1 v8 and net1 v9: is the v8 to v9 gap retraining noise?
description: In release exp-rule-paired-val-246 the rule on net1 v9 (exp-net1v9-243, run net1-v9-s2) at u 0.25 scores +0.140, +0.148 and +0.137 above BBRv3 for campaign seeds 11, 21 and 31, where the rule on net1 v8 (exp-net1v8-238, run net1-v8-s2) scored +0.158, +0.164 and +0.153 in release exp-rule-27heads-val-241. The two arms both releases share (net1 v7 at u 0.25 and neto1 v2 at u 0.375) agree within 0.001, so the releases are comparable and the gap of about 0.017 is not a run-to-run effect. It sits in the campaigns with a competitor (cubic-first -0.004 to -0.070, new +0.272 to +0.237 for seed 11). net1 v9 differs from net1 v8 only in the bins of random_loss_rate, which the rule does not read, and both were trained from seeds 0 to 2. This run puts the rule at u 0.25 on all three training seeds of each (arms v8s0, v8s1, v8s2, v9s0, v9s1, v9s2) with BBRv3 beside them, on the 21 validation links and five families, for campaign seeds 11 and 21. If the spread across training seeds of one net1 is as large as the gap, the gap is retraining noise and the choice of member should not be read as a v8 against v9 result; if every v8 seed beats every v9 seed, the bin change costs the rule something and needs a cause. Validation links only.
prepare: P=(); for a in v8:a v9:b; do k=${a%:*} i=${a#*:}; for s in 0 1 2; do uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/${k}s$s" "$IN/$i/net1-$k-s$s/net1.pt" --u 0.25; P+=(--policy "${k}s$s-u0.25=$OUT/${k}s$s/rule-u0.25.onnx"); done; done; for s in 11 21; do mkdir -p "$OUT/s$s"; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT/s$s" val $s $s bbr3 "${P[@]}"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/s*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: for s in 11 21; do uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT/s$s" --select v8s0 v8s1 v8s2 v9s0 v9s1 v9s2; done; { for s in 11 21; do echo "# Campaign seed $s"; cat "$OUT/s$s/summary.md"; echo; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
